title.ko: widerlegen · einräumen · zugestehen · wie dem auch sei · ungeachtet · alles in allem
title.en: Debate: widerlegen, einräumen, zugestehen, wie dem auch sei, ungeachtet, alles in allem

explain.ko: 토론의 핵심은 반박과 양보입니다. 반박: widerlegen(논박하다), kontern, einwenden, dass …(이의를 제기하다). 양보: einräumen, zugestehen(인정하다), zwar … aber. 정리 표현: wie dem auch sei(어쨌든), ungeachtet(격식, 그럼에도), alles in allem(전체적으로 보아). 입장 조정: differenzieren(뉘앙스를 주다), entscheiden(결론 내리다). 상대의 요점을 인정한 뒤 반박하는 구성이 설득력을 높입니다.
explain.en: Debate rests on rebuttal and concession. Rebuttal: widerlegen, kontern, einwenden, dass …. Concession: einräumen, zugestehen, zwar … aber. Closing phrases: wie dem auch sei (be that as it may), ungeachtet (formal, notwithstanding), alles in allem (on balance). Adjusting stance: differenzieren, entscheiden. Acknowledging the opponent's point before rebutting makes you more persuasive.

lines.t: Um eine Debatte zu gewinnen, genügt es nicht, den Gegner zu widerlegen. Man kann zuerst einen Punkt einräumen und dann differenzieren. Man könnte einwenden, diese Methode wirke schwach; im Gegenteil, sie stärkt die Glaubwürdigkeit. Alles in allem überzeugt sie mehr.

trans.ko: 좋은 토론은 상대를 이기는 것이 아니라 논점을 명확히 하는 것입니다. 상대의 좋은 점을 인정한 뒤 약점을 짚으면 신뢰를 얻습니다. 마지막에는 종합적으로 판단해 결론을 제시합니다.
trans.en: A good debate is not about defeating the opponent but about clarifying the points. Conceding the opponent's good points before pointing out weaknesses wins trust. In the end, you present a conclusion based on an overall judgement.

trans.ko:
토론 가이드
품위 있는 반박
반박하기 전에 상대의 논점을 정확히 요약하세요. 인정할 부분은 인정하고, 그렇다 하더라도 왜 결론이 달라지지 않는지 설명하세요. 마지막에는 종합적으로 판단한 결론을 제시하세요.
trans.en:
DEBATE GUIDE
Graceful rebuttal
Before rebutting, summarise the opponent's point accurately. Concede what should be conceded, and explain why, be that as it may, the conclusion does not change. At the end, give a conclusion based on an overall judgement.

trans.en: The guide says to summarise the opponent's point before rebutting. The guide says never to concede the opponent's claim. The guide says to give an overall conclusion.
